ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pigmentation with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters and lines; estimated ratio of 95:5 black to white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark contiguous pigmentation across visible lobes; distinct high-contrast white linear streaks on right lobe; dense clusters of light-colored circular pixels on distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the visible upper boundary with sharp peaks and jagged valleys relative to the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep resulting in an upward vertical orientation of the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast light pixels (barnacles) concentrated on the outer edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) unaligned and distributed across the dark fluke surface, primarily on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface colonization by barnacles on distal regions and multiple healed linear rake marks.
